title: AgriSeq Library Prep Part 1 - DNA Transfer (96)
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the number of samples and any other required settings for Part 1 (DNA Transfer) in the OT‑2 protocol interface.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated Python protocol file for AgriSeq Library Prep Part 1.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑2 App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.15.0 or later) and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons 96‑filter tip rack (20 µL), the ThermoFisher Scientific 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL, catalog AB‑0800), and the P20 multi‑channel pipette on the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, perform tip‑rack, labware, and pipette calibration following the on‑screen prompts.

steps.title: Distribute amplification mix and add DNA
steps.instruction: The robot will dispense 7 µL of Amplification Mix into each well of the 96‑well plate for the specified number of samples, then add 3 µL of sample DNA to each well containing Amplification Mix.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 7 µL Amplification Mix per well

steps.title: Monitor tip usage and replace if needed
steps.instruction: The OT‑2 tracks tip usage across Parts 1‑4 (e.g., tip leaves off in H11 at the end of Part 1; the first tip pick‑up in Part 2 will be from H12). If a tip rack is exhausted, the robot pauses and prompts you to replace all tip racks before continuing. Use the updated custom touch‑tip settings (adjusted July 18 2022).

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to execute the protocol.
